scenarios.name: Create a drawing from a sheet template

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-native-candidate.opj` as its active project
its Metric catalog contains the native standard part, assembly, drawing, sheet-metal and presentation templates

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+N to open the new-document template chooser
the new-document template chooser is open in the MCAD Software
a drawing template with a border and title block is available
the user selects the drawing template
the user chooses its Use Template preview
a new drawing document becomes active
its viewport displays a sheet with a border and title block
the drawing browser lists the sheet and its border
the ribbon offers drawing view commands
a new document tab is visible
